Service terms
https://767-2676.com/terms
True Witness Here
767-2676.com https://767-2676.com/
Service terms
767-2676.com provides signed temporal evidence. These terms describe the scope published in its service offer and witness protocol.
What you receive
A signed time response states the service’s time and validity window. A digest witness records when the supplied SHA-256 commitment was presented, together with the submitted nonce and optional predecessor digest.
Your data
Keep the original task and schedule bytes with you. The witness endpoint accepts the digest and the fields defined by its request schema. It rejects additional fields.
Payment
Each signed time response or digest witness costs 0.001 USDC on Base through x402. Read the current payment challenge before authorizing a payment. Public documentation, verification keys, and saved examples are free to read.
Using the evidence
Verify the signature, expected digest, nonce, predecessor where applicable, and time window before relying on a response. Apply your own task authority and boundary conditions. The signed scope covers temporal evidence; identity, authorization, execution, delivery, and outcome require their own evidence.
Network delay and clock uncertainty remain part of verification. A saved sample retains its original timestamp and validity window.

PROCEED and STOP are the example consumer policy at the recorded checkpoint. These receipts are historical. They do not authorize a task now or prove that the task was carried out.
The receipt records that POPCORN witnessed a digest at its stated time. The stated time interval is signed, but its clock accuracy is not independently established here. Bundled historical public keys make these records reproducible; real use requires an independently trusted issuer key.
The current verifier requires the whole witness interval inside the saved task window. Crossing a boundary requires a recheck and stays STOP on this page. A changed task or failed signature also returns STOP. No wallet, payment, task execution, or data submission is started by the sliders.

True Witness Here. FreeTSA + POPCORN checkpoint
https://767-2676.com/evidence/freetsa-popcorn-2026-10-14/README.md
True Witness Here. FreeTSA + POPCORN checkpoint
Two native signed attestations bind to the same exact 385-byte checkpoint file. The checkpoint was witnessed on October 14, 2026; this verification package was prepared October 16, 2026 (Pacific).
Run both verifications
Extract the ZIP into a writable folder. Install Node.js 20 or newer and OpenSSL 3.x, then run from the extracted folder:
node verify.mjs

The checker makes no network requests and no payments. It reads the original evidence without altering it. It writes fresh verification.json and verification.log results beside the script, replacing the included results when rerun. A passing run exits with status 0 and reports "status": "PASS" with 12 passing checks.
OpenSSL must be available as openssl, or set the OPENSSL environment variable to its executable path. On Windows, the checker also recognizes Git for Windows' OpenSSL at C:/Program Files/Git/usr/bin/openssl.exe.
$env:OPENSSL = 'C:/Program Files/Git/usr/bin/openssl.exe'
node verify.mjs

Exact underlying commands
The log contains the commands and their output from the published run:
openssl version
openssl ts -verify -data checkpoint.txt -in checkpoint.tsr -CAfile freetsa-cacert.pem -untrusted freetsa-tsa.crt
openssl ts -reply -in checkpoint.tsr -text

The timestamp verification returned Verification: OK. To inspect the file digest separately:
openssl dgst -sha256 checkpoint.txt

The expected SHA-256 is:
03eecd1ed8866d816e183834fbf7f94543ecca18d0a1adc0f3b798252e6058a2

For POPCORN, verify.mjs uses Node's crypto.verify with SHA-256, the published P-256 key, and the 64-byte IEEE-P1363 signature. It verifies the exact ASCII JWS signing input (encodedHeader.encodedPayload), requires ES256 and the expected key ID, checks the separately pinned key thumbprint, compares the complete outer witness_receipt to the signed JSON payload, and compares the signed payload digest to the file's SHA-256. The script also checks the stated interval and evidence scope.

Certificates and public keys were retrieved on October 16, 2026 (Pacific), separately from the receipt. The checker's trust starts with those issuer HTTPS endpoints and the fingerprints pinned in the script:
FreeTSA root certificate SHA-256 over DER bytes: a6379e7cecc05faa3cbf076013d745e327bbbaa38c0b9af22469d4701d18aabc.
POPCORN popcorn-witness-2026-01 RFC 7638 JWK SHA-256 thumbprint, base64url: ns4g75U5Bsn2bA3XtaSuQhDg065PVkhYgs3KOtJVPf0.
The package does not independently establish historical key ownership. A reader must decide whether to trust the stated sources and fingerprints; a package cannot establish that trust merely by including its own keys and checker. Certificate validity is evaluated by OpenSSL at the time of a rerun, so a future run can fail if certificates have expired.
Exact scope
The result establishes two valid signatures binding the same file digest under the stated keys. Busindre's independent confirmation on October 15 covered the FreeTSA timestamp/checkpoint match. It did not cover the POPCORN signature; that signature is checked by the portable script in this package.
FreeTSA's accuracy field is unspecified. No policy-supplied clock bound was verified. Strict-deadline reasoning from the FreeTSA side therefore remains indeterminate in this package. POPCORN's ±10-second interval is issuer-asserted, not an independently measured UTC error bound.
The checks do not validate the truth of the checkpoint's contents, prove action execution, grant authorization, or establish delivery. No certificate revocation checks or original .tsq request nonce comparison were performed. The package does not independently validate payment settlement, nonce freshness, or clock accuracy.

Lab record, 31 August 2026 | POPCORN
https://767-2676.com/lab-record
767-2676.com https://767-2676.com/ POPCORN 
Cross-model x402 payment lab record, 31 August 2026
On this date two models from different companies, Grok and Codex, coordinated one live payment to this service with nothing between them but text I copied and pasted. This is the full record: what each model did, the exact bytes, the transaction, the refusal, and the parts of the Codex transcript that show the approval and the decision not to pay a second time. It claims one settlement and one refusal, nothing more.
Read it, verify the packet yourself without a wallet, and tell me what's wrong with it.
PDF https://767-2676.com/lab-record.pdf· Markdown https://github.com/violetclaire/popcorn-temporal-anchor/blob/main/docs/lab-record-2026-08-31.md· Verify the packet https://github.com/violetclaire/popcorn-temporal-anchor/blob/main/examples/witness/evaluation-packet.proceed-002.production.json· Transaction on Base https://basescan.org/tx/0x477e726933c94ccad5682d03ecee4f3d5bb618387ac7437fc817bdd2fe946e5c 
One settlement and one refusal
In this operator-recorded test, Grok prepared an exact 228-byte replacement schedule after the original schedule expired. Violet Herod carried the protocol text between Grok and Codex by copy and paste. Codex reconstructed the bytes, checked the digest and live public state, and requested approval before the payment.
The approved payment was 0.001 USDC on Base. POPCORN issued a signed witness receipt for schedule 002. A later proposal carried a different digest without the exact bytes behind it; Codex declined the second payment.
Verify the exact artifact
Schedule 002 SHA-256, encoded as base64url:
kvYtty3Ifr6SMK8xU76uP0OowwGRCELi6nufb1hWh3M
The public PROCEED packet https://github.com/violetclaire/popcorn-temporal-anchor/blob/main/examples/witness/evaluation-packet.proceed-002.production.json contains the schedule bytes, digest, signed receipt, public verification key, settlement reference, and a one-byte tamper case. Verification of the saved packet requires no new payment. See the full text record and packet-specific verification command https://github.com/violetclaire/popcorn-temporal-anchor/blob/main/docs/lab-record-2026-08-31.md, or inspect the recorded transaction on Base https://basescan.org/tx/0x477e726933c94ccad5682d03ecee4f3d5bb618387ac7437fc817bdd2fe946e5c.
What the evidence means
The receipt provides signed evidence that a particular digest was presented within a recorded time interval. Checking the original bytes against the digest detects changes. The agent applies its own schedule and authorization rules.
This was one human-mediated test. It does not establish direct autonomous communication between the models, a general safety guarantee, task authorization, or proof of downstream execution.
The first outside payment
On October 27, 2026, an agent with no relationship to this house found the witness from what was published here, checked a receipt against the published keys by itself, and paid $0.001 from its own wallet for a receipt of its own. It was given nothing: no key, no account, no custody. Checked alone and paid alone. The witness only witnessed.

https://767-2676.com/.well-known/briarwood-inquiry.schema.json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "https://767-2676.com/.well-known/briarwood-inquiry.schema.json",
  "title": "Briarwood Participant-Local Inquiry Exchange",
  "description": "Read-only contract for a direct node-to-node inquiry, scoped response, expiry, and optional authorized referral. 767-2676.com publishes this contract and stores or answers no inquiry instances.",
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "schema_version",
    "exchange_id",
    "record_state",
    "operational",
    "signature_material_state",
    "request",
    "response",
    "verification_sequence",
    "storage_contract"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "schema_version": {
      "type": "string",
      "const": "1.0.0"
    },
    "exchange_id": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/machine_identifier"
    },
    "record_state": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "example",
        "active",
        "terminal"
      ]
    },
    "operational": {
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "signature_material_state": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "live",
        "placeholder_non_verifiable"
      ]
    },
    "request": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/inquiry_request"
    },
    "response": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/inquiry_response"
    },
    "verification_sequence": {
      "type": "array",
      "minItems": 7,
      "uniqueItems": true,
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "enum": [
          "verify_request_message_attestation",
          "verify_request_popcorn_anchor",
          "validate_execution_window_utc",
          "apply_responder_local_policy",
          "verify_response_message_attestation",
          "verify_response_popcorn_anchor",
          "enforce_response_valid_until_utc",
          "select_authorized_referral_or_terminate"
        ]
      }
    },
    "storage_contract": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/storage_contract"
    }
  },
  "$defs": {
    "machine_identifier": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 160,
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9](?:[A-Za-z0-9._:@/-]*[A-Za-z0-9])?$"
    },
    "node_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 160,
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9](?:[A-Za-z0-9._:@/-]*[A-Za-z0-9])?$"
    },
    "execution_window_utc": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "opens_at_utc",
        "closes_at_utc"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "opens_at_utc": {
          "type": "string",
          "format": "date-time"
        },
        "closes_at_utc": {
          "type": "string",
          "format": "date-time"
        }
      }
    },
    "popcorn_anchor": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Bearer temporal evidence from 767-2676.com. POPCORN signs time only and does not sign or authorize the inquiry, response, resource, or referral.",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "anchor_id",
        "node_id",
        "protocol_id",
        "time_utc",
        "valid_until_utc",
        "evidence_scope",
        "verification_key_set_url",
        "compact_jws"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "anchor_id": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/machine_identifier"
        },
        "node_id": {
          "type": "string",
          "const": "767-2676.com"
        },
        "protocol_id": {
          "type": "string",
          "const": "POPCORN/1.0"
        },
        "time_utc": {
          "type": "string",
          "format": "date-time"
        },
        "valid_until_utc": {
          "type": "string",
          "format": "date-time"
        },
        "evidence_scope": {
          "type": "string",
          "const": "bearer_temporal_evidence"
        },
        "verification_key_set_url": {
          "type": "string",
          "const": "https://767-2676.com/.well-known/popcorn-keys.json"
        },
        "compact_jws": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1
        }
      }
    },
    "participant_attestation": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Participant signature over the RFC 8785 canonical JSON representation of the containing message with message_attestation omitted. This binds the participant assertion to the included POPCORN anchor_id without changing POPCORN's time-only evidence scope.",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "format",
        "algorithm",
        "key_id",
        "verification_key_set_url",
        "payload_serialization",
        "payload_scope",
        "compact_jws"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "format": {
          "type": "string",
          "const": "JWS"
        },
        "algorithm": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": [
            "ES256",
            "EdDSA"
          ]
        },
        "key_id": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/machine_identifier"
        },
        "verification_key_set_url": {
          "type": "string",
          "format": "uri",
          "pattern": "^https://"
        },
        "payload_serialization": {
          "type": "string",
          "const": "RFC8785-JCS"
        },
        "payload_scope": {
          "type": "string",
          "const": "containing_message_without_message_attestation"
        },
        "compact_jws": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1
        }
      }
    },
    "inquiry_request": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "protocol_id",
        "message_type",
        "inquiry_id",
        "node_id",
        "resource_id",
        "task_payload",
        "execution_window_utc",
        "popcorn_anchor",
        "message_attestation"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "protocol_id": {
          "type": "string",
          "const": "BRIARWOOD-INQUIRY/1.0"
        },
        "message_type": {
          "type": "string",
          "const": "inquiry_request"
        },
        "inquiry_id": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/machine_identifier"
        },
        "node_id": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/node_id"
        },
        "resource_id": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/machine_identifier"
        },
        "task_payload": {
          "type": "object",
          "description": "Narrow machine-native inquiry only. Private schedules, pricing, identity data, and unrelated task state remain participant-local."
        },
        "execution_window_utc": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/execution_window_utc"
        },
        "popcorn_anchor": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/popcorn_anchor"
        },
        "message_attestation": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/participant_attestation"
        }
      }
    },
    "referral_offer": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "node_id",
        "inquiry_endpoint",
        "authorization_reference",
        "disclosure_scope",
        "valid_until_utc"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "node_id": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/node_id"
        },
        "inquiry_endpoint": {
          "type": "string",
          "format": "uri",
          "pattern": "^https://"
        },
        "authorization_reference": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/machine_identifier"
        },
        "disclosure_scope": {
          "type": "string",
          "const": "single_inquiry"
        },
        "valid_until_utc": {
          "type": "string",
          "format": "date-time"
        }
      }
    },
    "inquiry_response": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "protocol_id",
        "message_type",
        "inquiry_id",
        "node_id",
        "resource_id",
        "availability_state",
        "valid_until_utc",
        "next_action",
        "referral_state",
        "popcorn_anchor",
        "message_attestation"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "protocol_id": {
          "type": "string",
          "const": "BRIARWOOD-INQUIRY/1.0"
        },
        "message_type": {
          "type": "string",
          "const": "inquiry_response"
        },
        "inquiry_id": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/machine_identifier"
        },
        "node_id": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/node_id"
        },
        "resource_id": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/machine_identifier"
        },
        "availability_state": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": [
            "available",
            "unavailable",
            "unknown",
            "unauthorized",
            "incompatible",
            "expired"
          ]
        },
        "valid_until_utc": {
          "type": "string",
          "format": "date-time"
        },
        "next_action": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": [
            "continue_task",
            "terminate",
            "await_callback",
            "select_authorized_referral",
            "request_new_temporal_anchor"
          ]
        },
        "referral_state": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": [
            "not_requested",
            "not_available",
            "offered",
            "accepted",
            "declined",
            "expired"
          ]
        },
        "referral_offer": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/referral_offer"
        },
        "popcorn_anchor": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/popcorn_anchor"
        },
        "message_attestation": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/participant_attestation"
        }
      },
      "allOf": [
        {
          "if": {
            "required": [
              "referral_state"
            ],
            "properties": {
              "referral_state": {
                "const": "offered"
              }
            }
          },
          "then": {
            "required": [
              "referral_offer"
            ]
          }
        }
      ]
    },
    "storage_contract": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "storage_scope",
        "popcorn_stores_exchange",
        "global_inquiry_registry",
        "global_availability_registry",
        "retained_records",
        "cleared_ephemeral_state"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "storage_scope": {
          "type": "string",
          "const": "participant_local"
        },
        "popcorn_stores_exchange": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "const": false
        },
        "global_inquiry_registry": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "const": false
        },
        "global_availability_registry": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "const": false
        },
        "retained_records": {
          "type": "array",
          "uniqueItems": true,
          "items": {
            "type": "string",
            "enum": [
              "signed_inquiry_request",
              "signed_inquiry_response",
              "verified_popcorn_receipts",
              "participant_local_decision_receipt"
            ]
          }
        },
        "cleared_ephemeral_state": {
          "type": "array",
          "uniqueItems": true,
          "items": {
            "type": "string",
            "enum": [
              "retry_counter",
              "transient_route_state",
              "payment_proof",
              "unselected_referral_candidates"
            ]
          }
        }
      }
    }
  },
  "x-briarwood-contract": {
    "protocol_id": "BRIARWOOD-INQUIRY/1.0",
    "publication_scope": "read_only_contract_and_example",
    "transport_scope": "participant_to_participant",
    "participant_storage_required": true,
    "node_operates_global_inquiry_endpoint": false,
    "node_stores_inquiry_instances": false,
    "global_availability_registry": false,
    "global_referral_registry": false,
    "initial_peer_state": {
      "peers": []
    },
    "assertion_boundaries": {
      "popcorn_asserts": [
        "time_utc",
        "valid_until_utc",
        "temporal_origin"
      ],
      "participant_asserts": [
        "inquiry_contents",
        "availability_state",
        "response_valid_until_utc",
        "authorized_referral_offer"
      ],
      "popcorn_task_bound": false,
      "participant_message_binds_popcorn_anchor_id": true
    },
    "semantic_validation": [
      "request_and_response_inquiry_id_must_match",
      "request_and_response_resource_id_must_match",
      "execution_window_close_must_follow_open",
      "both_popcorn_compact_jws_values_must_verify_against_the_pinned_popcorn_jwks",
      "both_participant_message_attestations_must_verify_against_the_declared_participant_jwks",
      "participant_jws_payload_must_equal_rfc8785_canonical_message_without_message_attestation",
      "popcorn_anchor_id_must_be_covered_by_the_participant_message_attestation",
      "popcorn_evidence_proves_time_only_and_must_not_be_treated_as_availability_or_authorization",
      "response_valid_until_utc_must_be_enforced_by_the_requesting_node",
      "referral_offer_requires_explicit_participant_local_authorization",
      "referral_offer_valid_until_utc_must_not_precede_response_valid_until_utc",
      "retry_must_stop_at_execution_window_close"
    ]
  }
}

Published document text
schemas/execution-schedule.v1.json
https://767-2676.com/schemas/execution-schedule.v1.json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "https://767-2676.com/schemas/execution-schedule.v1.json",
  "title": "POPCORN Portable Execution Schedule",
  "description": "Read-only contract for an agent-carried, participant-local sequence of time-bounded execution events. 767-2676.com publishes this schema and stores no schedule instances.",
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "schema_version",
    "schedule_id",
    "schedule_revision",
    "node_id",
    "issued_at_utc",
    "valid_until_utc",
    "schedule_state",
    "current_event_id",
    "outcome_payload",
    "coordination_policy",
    "events"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "schema_version": {
      "type": "string",
      "const": "1.0.0"
    },
    "schedule_id": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/machine_identifier"
    },
    "schedule_revision": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1
    },
    "node_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 160,
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9](?:[A-Za-z0-9._:@/-]*[A-Za-z0-9])?$"
    },
    "issued_at_utc": {
      "type": "string",
      "format": "date-time"
    },
    "valid_until_utc": {
      "type": "string",
      "format": "date-time"
    },
    "schedule_state": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "active",
        "completed",
        "expired",
        "cancelled"
      ]
    },
    "current_event_id": {
      "oneOf": [
        {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/machine_identifier"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ]
    },
    "outcome_payload": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Participant-local definition of the required result that schedule recovery must preserve."
    },
    "coordination_policy": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/coordination_policy"
    },
    "events": {
      "type": "array",
      "minItems": 1,
      "maxItems": 1000,
      "items": {
        "$ref": "#/$defs/execution_event"
      }
    }
  },
  "$defs": {
    "machine_identifier": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 160,
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9](?:[A-Za-z0-9._:@/-]*[A-Za-z0-9])?$"
    },
    "execution_window_utc": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "opens_at_utc",
        "closes_at_utc"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "opens_at_utc": {
          "type": "string",
          "format": "date-time"
        },
        "closes_at_utc": {
          "type": "string",
          "format": "date-time"
        }
      }
    },
    "planned_execution_utc": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "starts_at_utc",
        "ends_at_utc"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "starts_at_utc": {
          "type": "string",
          "format": "date-time"
        },
        "ends_at_utc": {
          "type": "string",
          "format": "date-time"
        }
      }
    },
    "attempt_policy": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "max_attempts",
        "backoff",
        "stop_at_window_close"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "max_attempts": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 1,
          "maximum": 100
        },
        "backoff": {
          "type": "string",
          "const": "bounded_exponential_with_jitter"
        },
        "stop_at_window_close": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "const": true
        }
      }
    },
    "coordination_policy": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "time_source",
        "drift_measurement",
        "recovery_mode",
        "outcome_priority",
        "allow_independent_event_resequence",
        "stop_at_schedule_close",
        "unbounded_retry"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "time_source": {
          "type": "string",
          "const": "popcorn_temporal_anchor"
        },
        "drift_measurement": {
          "type": "string",
          "const": "observed_time_minus_planned_time_ms"
        },
        "recovery_mode": {
          "type": "string",
          "const": "bounded_resequence_remaining_events"
        },
        "outcome_priority": {
          "type": "string",
          "const": "preserve_required_outcome"
        },
        "allow_independent_event_resequence": {
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "stop_at_schedule_close": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "const": true
        },
        "unbounded_retry": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "const": false
        }
      }
    },
    "timing_policy": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "expected_duration_ms",
        "buffer_after_ms",
        "drift_tolerance_ms"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "expected_duration_ms": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0
        },
        "buffer_after_ms": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0
        },
        "drift_tolerance_ms": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0
        }
      }
    },
    "execution_context": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "assigned_node_ids",
        "location_mode",
        "origin_location_ref",
        "destination_location_ref"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "assigned_node_ids": {
          "type": "array",
          "minItems": 1,
          "uniqueItems": true,
          "items": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1,
            "maxLength": 160
          }
        },
        "location_mode": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": [
            "physical",
            "network",
            "hybrid",
            "not_applicable"
          ]
        },
        "origin_location_ref": {
          "oneOf": [
            {
              "type": "string",
              "minLength": 1,
              "maxLength": 2048
            },
            {
              "type": "null"
            }
          ]
        },
        "destination_location_ref": {
          "oneOf": [
            {
              "type": "string",
              "minLength": 1,
              "maxLength": 2048
            },
            {
              "type": "null"
            }
          ]
        }
      }
    },
    "drift_state": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "observed_drift_ms",
        "reason_code",
        "recovery_action",
        "recalculated_at_utc"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "observed_drift_ms": {
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "reason_code": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": [
            "execution_delay",
            "dependency_delay",
            "resource_unavailable",
            "network_delay",
            "policy_interruption",
            "unknown"
          ]
        },
        "recovery_action": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": [
            "continue",
            "compress_buffer",
            "resequence_independent_events",
            "handoff_event",
            "release_event",
            "terminate_event"
          ]
        },
        "recalculated_at_utc": {
          "type": "string",
          "format": "date-time"
        }
      }
    },
    "popcorn_anchor": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "anchor_id",
        "time_utc",
        "valid_until_utc",
        "compact_jws"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "anchor_id": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/machine_identifier"
        },
        "time_utc": {
          "type": "string",
          "format": "date-time"
        },
        "valid_until_utc": {
          "type": "string",
          "format": "date-time"
        },
        "compact_jws": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1
        }
      }
    },
    "terminal_receipt": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "receipt_id",
        "terminal_state",
        "recorded_at_utc",
        "task_payload_digest"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "receipt_id": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/machine_identifier"
        },
        "terminal_state": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": [
            "completed",
            "expired",
            "released",
            "handed_off"
          ]
        },
        "recorded_at_utc": {
          "type": "string",
          "format": "date-time"
        },
        "task_payload_digest": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^sha256:[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$"
        }
      }
    },
    "execution_event": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "event_id",
        "sequence_index",
        "resource_id",
        "task_payload",
        "execution_window_utc",
        "planned_execution_utc",
        "execution_context",
        "dependency_event_ids",
        "timing_policy",
        "state",
        "next_action",
        "attempt_policy"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "event_id": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/machine_identifier"
        },
        "sequence_index": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0
        },
        "resource_id": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/machine_identifier"
        },
        "task_payload": {
          "type": "object"
        },
        "task_payload_digest": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^sha256:[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$"
        },
        "execution_window_utc": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/execution_window_utc"
        },
        "planned_execution_utc": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/planned_execution_utc"
        },
        "execution_context": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/execution_context"
        },
        "dependency_event_ids": {
          "type": "array",
          "uniqueItems": true,
          "items": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/machine_identifier"
          }
        },
        "timing_policy": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/timing_policy"
        },
        "drift_state": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/drift_state"
        },
        "state": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": [
            "scheduled",
            "eligible",
            "executing",
            "delayed",
            "recovering",
            "completed",
            "expired",
            "released",
            "handed_off"
          ]
        },
        "next_action": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": [
            "await_window",
            "ground_time",
            "execute_task",
            "measure_drift",
            "resequence_schedule",
            "resume_task",
            "advance_schedule",
            "terminate_schedule",
            "release_resource",
            "submit_handoff"
          ]
        },
        "attempt_policy": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/attempt_policy"
        },
        "popcorn_anchor": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/popcorn_anchor"
        },
        "terminal_receipt": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/terminal_receipt"
        }
      },
      "allOf": [
        {
          "if": {
            "required": [
              "state"
            ],
            "properties": {
              "state": {
                "enum": [
                  "completed",
                  "expired",
                  "released",
                  "handed_off"
                ]
              }
            }
          },
          "then": {
            "required": [
              "terminal_receipt"
            ]
          }
        }
      ]
    }
  },
  "x-popcorn-contract": {
    "time_anchor_endpoint": "/v1/time",
    "time_anchor_legacy_endpoint": "/time?format=json",
    "storage_scope": "participant_local",
    "transport_scope": "agent_carried",
    "node_stores_schedule_instances": false,
    "state_machine": {
      "initial_state": "scheduled",
      "active_states": [
        "eligible",
        "executing",
        "delayed",
        "recovering"
      ],
      "terminal_states": [
        "completed",
        "expired",
        "released",
        "handed_off"
      ]
    },
    "judgment_contract": {
      "inputs": [
        "execution_window_utc",
        "planned_execution_utc",
        "execution_context",
        "dependency_event_ids",
        "timing_policy",
        "drift_state",
        "outcome_payload"
      ],
      "within_tolerance_action": "continue",
      "outside_tolerance_action": "increment_schedule_revision_and_resequence_remaining_events",
      "outcome_priority": "preserve_required_outcome",
      "schedule_close_is_terminal": true
    },
    "semantic_validation": [
      "schedule_valid_until_utc_must_follow_issued_at_utc",
      "execution_window_close_must_follow_open",
      "planned_execution_end_must_follow_start",
      "planned_execution_must_fit_within_execution_window",
      "expected_duration_ms_must_match_planned_execution_duration",
      "event_windows_must_fit_within_schedule_validity",
      "event_ids_must_be_unique",
      "sequence_indexes_must_be_unique_and_contiguous",
      "dependency_event_ids_must_resolve_and_be_acyclic",
      "current_event_id_must_resolve_or_be_null",
      "assigned_node_ids_must_be_participant_authorized",
      "location_refs_must_be_participant_authorized",
      "non_null_location_refs_required_unless_location_mode_not_applicable",
      "popcorn_anchor_must_be_valid_at_each_time_judgment",
      "observed_drift_ms_must_be_derived_from_the_planned_timeline",
      "resequence_must_increment_schedule_revision",
      "resequence_must_not_reopen_terminal_events",
      "terminal_receipt_state_must_match_event_state",
      "recovery_must_not_extend_execution_beyond_schedule_close"
    ],
    "reset_contract": {
      "trigger": "terminal_receipt_recorded",
      "retain": [
        "terminal_receipt"
      ],
      "clear_before_next_event": [
        "resource_lock",
        "payment_proof",
        "retry_counter",
        "transient_task_state"
      ]
    }
  }
}

Published document text
schemas/witness-request.v1.json
https://767-2676.com/schemas/witness-request.v1.json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "https://767-2676.com/schemas/witness-request.v1.json",
  "title": "POPCORN payload-bound witness request v1",
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "payload_digest",
    "nonce",
    "previous_attestation_digest"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "payload_digest": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "algorithm",
        "value"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "algorithm": {
          "type": "string",
          "const": "sha-256"
        },
        "value": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$",
          "description": "Canonical unpadded base64url encoding of exactly 32 bytes."
        }
      }
    },
    "nonce": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$",
      "description": "Canonical unpadded base64url encoding of 32 random bytes."
    },
    "previous_attestation_digest": {
      "description": "SHA-256 over the exact signed payload bytes of the predecessor compact JWS, obtained by base64url-decoding its second segment. The digest value uses the same canonical unpadded base64url encoding as payload_digest. Null starts a chain.",
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "object",
          "additionalProperties": false,
          "required": [
            "algorithm",
            "value"
          ],
          "properties": {
            "algorithm": {
              "type": "string",
              "const": "sha-256"
            },
            "value": {
              "type": "string",
              "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$",
              "description": "Canonical unpadded base64url encoding of exactly 32 bytes."
            }
          }
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ]
    }
  }
}

schemas/witness-response.v1.json
https://767-2676.com/schemas/witness-response.v1.json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "https://767-2676.com/schemas/witness-response.v1.json",
  "title": "POPCORN payload-bound witness response v1",
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "witness_receipt",
    "witness_attestation",
    "payment_status"
